title: Lure Him Up, Then Pull the Ladder
era: Early Western Han · about 2,200 years ago

source.chapter: Lure Him Up, Then Pull the Ladder
source.quote: Give him the convenience; prompt him forward, cut off his support, and leave him stranded where he stands.

moral: Give him the easy way up first — once he is up there, the ladder is yours.
transfer: Say what you will help with, and where you stop.
